_about: VizDOM session config. Provide via connect(<this file>) or the Robot Framework 'Connect' keyword. All values below are defaults; delete any you don't want to override.

_help.detector: Stage 2 - element detection backend and its parameters
_help.detector.backend: uied (CPU baseline) | yolo | omniparser (best actionable) | hybrid
_help.detector.omniparser_text_ensemble: feed VizDOM OCR into OmniParser to recover text (ADR-016)
_help.detector.omniparser_box_threshold: YOLO icon confidence cutoff (default 0.05); lower to ~0.03 to recover faint glyphs like a minimize button
_help.detector.grpc_target: host:port of a running detector gRPC service (used only when backend == 'grpc', ADR-017)
_help.refiner: Stage 8 - optional small-LM/VLM element review (needs a running backend)
_help.merge.cross_type_iou: suppress overlapping boxes of different types above this IoU
_help.merge.merge_oversegmented: fuse split multi-line labels/buttons back together
_help.hierarchy.containment_threshold: fraction of a child's area that must sit inside its parent
_help.symbols: Stage 4c - glyph/operator reading (+ - = x / etc.) via template matching
_help.symbols.min_score: null = structure decides (default); a value adds a template-agreement veto (raise = stricter)
_help.capture: how screens are acquired (RF client layer, ADR-018)
_help.capture.strategy: null=auto | windows | linux | android | camera | grpc | <plugin>
_help.capture.window_title: app under test to raise: window title, or package[/.Activity] on Android (ADR-021)
_help.capture.focus_before_capture: raise window_title before every grab, so the DOM is built from the app under test and not from whatever window is on top
_help.capture.window_scope: capture ONLY window_title's client area instead of the whole screen, so the DOM contains just that app (implies focusing; falls back to full screen with a warning if the strategy cannot)
_help.actuator: how input is delivered (RF client layer, ADR-019)
_help.actuator.target: host:port of a running actuator gRPC service (when strategy == grpc)
_help.actuator.window_title: app to raise for input; null = inherit capture.window_title (ADR-021)
_help.grounding: desc= locator resolution (ADR-022): tiered natural-language grounding
_help.grounding.tiers: escalation order; lexical (no model) | slm (text LM over DOM) | vlm (Set-of-Mark over image, opt-in)
